title: Priming Lexicon and Quantization Robustness for Multimodal Onboarding
author: Maya Chen
body:
Summary
-------
This document defines a standard priming lexicon and a complementary robustness test matrix for onboarding multimodal models into Redwood's serving fleet, with a focus on quantized artifact resilience, priming stability across modalities, and explicit triage steps when degradation is observed. It is intended for Applied ML engineers, model onboarding owners, and evaluator teams responsible for promotion to shadow/dedicated/private stages.

Background and motivation
-------------------------
- Multimodal models (image+text, audio+text) show different failure modes under lower-precision kernels and KV-cache interactions.
- Current onboarding checklists focus on textual coherence and latency; this doc fills the gap for "priming" (how we initialize context across modalities) and explicit quantization robustness tests.
- Aligns with Redwood's production-first thesis: predictability and measurable regression guards before rolling to hosted/dedicated/private.

Goals
-----
1. Define a canonical priming lexicon (phrases, structure, metadata) used by eval harnesses and shadow traffic to ensure consistent prompting across services.
2. Provide a quant-robustness test matrix covering precision modes (fp16, int8, mixed), KV-cache stress, and multimodal encoding edge cases.
3. Specify telemetry, pass/fail thresholds, and an automated triage flow for regressions.
4. Offer a lightweight config snippet and example CLI commands to run the suite locally and in CI.

Scope
-----
- Applies to multimodal encoder-decoder and decoder-only families onboarded to Redwood's runtime.
- Includes both synthetic priming probes and live-traffic shadow probes.
- Excludes: model training guidance, hardware procurement, and customer-specific prompt engineering.

Definitions
-----------
- Priming lexicon: curated set of tokens/phrases and structure used to initialize the model across modalities (e.g., <IMG_DESC> ... <TEXT_PROMPT>).
- Quantization mode: the execution precision/configuration used (e.g., fp16, int8-static, int8-dynamic, mixed16/8).
- Shadow probe: a probe derived from live traffic but anonymized and reweighted for eval.

Priming lexicon: structure and examples
-------------------------------------
Design principles:
- Deterministic anchors: include a short, deterministic anchor sentence to stabilize generation (e.g., "Context anchor: describe the content concisely.")
- Modality markers: explicit tokens that indicate modality boundaries (TEXT_START, IMAGE_START, AUDIO_START)
- Minimalism: prefer concise anchors to avoid excessive token budgets and reduce KV-cache divergence.
- Diagnostic suffixes: append structured diagnostic fields when running evals: [PRIME_ID=xxx][SEED=42][MODE=shadow]

Canonical priming templates (examples)
- Image caption baseline:
  IMAGE_START
  <IMG_HASH>
  Context anchor: Describe the main subject and visible attributes in one sentence.
  TEXT_START
  Provide a concise caption.

- Multiturn assistant with image:
  TEXT_START
  User: I uploaded an image showing a chart. Provide a summary and 3 action items.
  IMAGE_START
  <IMG_HASH>
  DIAGNOSTIC: [PRIME_ID=chart-summarize][MODE=shadow]

Quantization robustness test matrix (table)
-----------------------------------------
| Test name | Input modality | Quant modes | Stressor | Metric | Pass threshold | Notes |
|-----------|----------------|-------------|----------|--------|----------------|-------|
| Priming-stability-image-anchors | image+text | fp16, int8-static, int8-dyn | image noise, resized to 64-2048 px | caption semantic overlap (BLEU/ROUGE) + embedding cosine | >= 0.87 cosine vs fp16 baseline | run 500 seeds per image family |
| KV-cache-consistency | long-conversation text | fp16, mixed8 | repeated prefix inflations | token-stream divergence ratio | <= 0.05 | measure at token 256 and 1024 |
| Modality-fallback-sanity | image absent but marker present | int8-dyn | missing modality | hallucination rate | <= 0.02 | detectors for hallucinated entities |
| Latency-tail-quant | multimodal batch | int8-static | microburst batching | p99 latency increase vs fp16 | <= 1.35x | target region-specific kernels |

Onboarding checklist (promote model -> shadow -> canary -> prod)
----------------------------------------------------------------
1. Preflight: run unit evaluations and ensure deterministic seed-based artifact generation for priming templates (artifact hashes stored in artifact-registry).
2. Quant-compatibility run: execute the quant-robustness matrix across the supported quant modes. Attach generated metrics to the model artifact metadata.
3. Shadow validation: launch shadow probes (1% of traffic equivalence) with priming lexicon enabled. Run for 48h or 500k generated tokens, whichever is sooner.
4. Canary rollout: if shadow passes, canary 5% traffic for 24h using mixed precision and KV-cache warming; enable automated rollback ACL.
5. Production promotion: require 4 consecutive days of stable SLOs and no regression ticket older than 24h in alerting queue.

Automated test runner: example config snippet
-------------------------------------------
(Place in eval-runner configs as eval/priming-quant.json)

{
  "suite_name": "priming-quant-robustness",
  "priming_templates": ["image-caption-baseline","multiturn-assistant-image"],
  "quant_modes": ["fp16","int8-dyn","mixed8"],
  "iterations_per_test": 500
}

CLI example
-----------
- Local run: 
  ./tools/eval-runner --config eval/priming-quant.json --model-repo /mnt/models/repo --mode local --out results/prime-2026.json
- CI run: 
  ci/eval-job --suite priming-quant-robustness --artifact $MODEL_ARTIFACT --commit $GITHUB_SHA

Telemetry, metrics and SLOs
--------------------------
- Primary metrics collected per-test: embedding_cosine_vs_fp16, semantic_score, hallucination_rate, p50/p95/p99 latency.
- SLOs for onboarding: embedding_cosine_vs_fp16 >= 0.87, hallucination_rate <= 0.03, p99_latency <= 1.5x baseline.
- Alerting: create a regression ticket automatically if any metric crosses a soft threshold (cosine<0.89) and page on hard thresholds (cosine<0.85 or hallucination>0.05).

Failure modes and triage playbook
--------------------------------
- If embedding_cosine drops by 0.03 vs fp16:
  1. Re-run with different seeds and higher iteration (x5) to reduce stochastic variance.
  2. Run per-slice breakdown (by modality, image resolution, language) to isolate failing cohorts.
  3. If concentrated on quant mode int8-static, escalate to Quant team for kernel re-evaluation.
- If hallucination_rate increases for missing-modality probes: revert to previous priming anchor and run a targeted priming-ablation test to identify sensitive tokens.

Manual inspection checklist
-------------------------
- Sample failed probes (50) and annotate: failure class, severity, suggested fix.
- Check model logits snapshots (use eval-logcat) at token positions where divergence observed.
- Verify KV-cache key consistency across quant modes (use kv-inspect tool).

Rollout and rollback controls
----------------------------
- Canary policy: automatic rollback if any of these occur during canary window:
  - embedding_cosine drop > 0.04 vs baseline
  - hallucination_rate increase > 0.05 absolute
  - sustained latency p99 > 2x baseline for 15m
- Rollback mechanism: canary toggles are controlled by rollout-service; to rollback manually: run 
  rollout-service rollback --model $MODEL_ID --to-tag previous-stable --reason "quant-regression"

Ownership and escalation
-----------------------
- Onboarding owner: Applied ML Team (primary: @maya.chen).
- Quant compatibility owner: Platform Performance (secondary: @liam.oconnor).
- Escalation path: owner -> quant team -> runtime-kernel -> SRE oncall. Include model artifact id and full eval-run results in the ticket.

Appendix: sample probe generation recipe
--------------------------------------
1. Select 200 representative images from the multimodal dataset, stratified by resolution and domain.
2. Generate priming variants: clean, resized, gaussian-noise(+10, +20), blurred, occluded.
3. For each variant, produce 50 prompt seeds using the canonical priming lexicon with diagnostic suffixes.
4. Run against fp16 baseline and each quant mode; store all outputs and embeddings.
